description: List the customers - accounts that sign in to the user's site (records of an accounts model), with status, verification, last login, their company and orderStats (non-canceled order count, last order date, and net spend = paid minus refunded, in minor units, one entry per currency; null when the caller may not view orders). Not the team: those are list_team. Read-only; filter by model, status, company or an identity search; paginated, newest first.

companyId.description: Only customers linked to this company record

modelId.description: Only customers of this accounts model (id from list_models)

search.description: Case-insensitive match against the sign-in identity (email)

name: list_customers
